settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 1-2 business days and delivered worldwide. You will receive a tracking link by email as soon as your parcel leaves our studio.

settings.question: Can I return a journal or planner?
settings.answer: Yes. You have 30 days to return unused items in their original packaging. Send us a message through our contact page and we will arrange the return for you.

settings.question: What kind of paper do you use?
settings.answer: Our journals are printed on smooth, fountain-pen friendly paper that resists bleeding and keeps fine detail crisp, so you can write with any pen you prefer.

settings.question: Can I choose my delivery date?
settings.answer: Yes. At checkout you can select the delivery date that suits you best, and we will make sure your order arrives on the day you choose.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: We ship worldwide. Delivery times and shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your location.
